name: codex-guard
description: Pre-submit hygiene checks for AI-generated pull requests: TODO leftovers, hardcoded secrets, and sloppy commit subjects.

interface.shortDescription: Pre-submit PR hygiene checks for agent-authored work
interface.longDescription: Before opening or updating a pull request, Codex Guard runs the same deterministic checks its GitHub Action enforces in CI: leftover TODO/FIXME markers, hardcoded secrets (AWS/GitHub/OpenAI/npm/SendGrid/Telegram/Azure/JWT and more), and non-conventional commit subjects. The agent fixes findings and only submits a clean diff, so the CI gate and human review see real design questions instead of cleanup work.
interface.defaultPrompt: Before opening or updating a pull request, run codex-guard's pre-submit checks on the current diff and fix TODO leftovers, hardcoded secrets, and non-conventional commit subjects.
